title: CoupVisor: Strategy Optimization by Round and Challenge Decision Support
abstract: arXiv:2608.15868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents CoupVisor, a decision-support system for the hidden-information card game Coup. It addresses two questions: what a player should do on each turn, and when a player should challenge an opponent's claim. The system is built around a single description of game events, which is shared across manual play, replay of recorded games, simulation, belief tracking, advisor recommendations, and learning-based policies. CoupVisor estimates the chance that a claim is truthful by combining how likely each role is with how many cards the claimant still holds, which corrects a case where the very first claim of a game was flagged as suspicious despite no evidence. We compare a rule-following advisor and several learned and heuristic players across many simulated games and different opponent styles. Our main finding is that the choice of reward, whether it rewards short-term gains or ultimately winning the game, decides which learning

translated_title: CoupVisor：通过回合与挑战决策支持进行策略优化
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了CoupVisor，一个用于隐藏信息卡牌游戏《Coup》的决策支持系统。它解决两个问题：玩家在每个回合应该做什么，以及玩家何时应该质疑对手的声明。该系统围绕游戏事件的单一描述构建，该描述在手动游戏、录制游戏回放、模拟、信念跟踪、顾问建议和基于学习的策略之间共享。CoupVisor通过结合每个角色的可能性与声明者仍持有的卡牌数量来估计声明真实的概率，这纠正了一个情况：游戏中的第一个声明在没有证据的情况下被标记为可疑。我们比较了一个遵循规则的顾问和多个学习型及启发式玩家在众多模拟游戏和不同对手风格中的表现。我们的主要发现是，奖励的选择——无论是奖励短期收益还是最终赢得游戏——决定了哪种学习策略占优。
tldr: CoupVisor通过结合角色概率和剩余卡牌数来准确评估声明真实性，并发现奖励函数（短期收益 vs 最终胜利）是决定学习策略优劣的关键因素。
en_tdlr: CoupVisor accurately assesses claim truthfulness by combining role probabilities and remaining cards, and finds that the reward function (short-term gain vs. ultimate victory) is the key factor determining the superiority of learning strategies.
